status: Targeted preference navigation and dismiss host migration, with shared action paint invalidation correction. Full matrices remain reserved for larger blocks.

snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. Twenty-one prototype source hashes are matched to committed, live and staged inputs.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

build_scope.limit: Current-main network policy excluded from this frozen UI-lab binary and acceptance.

contracts: Ten preference category controls and preference/tools dismiss controls now use ScenePreferenceButton derived from RustActionView/View, without Button/ButtonController instances. Native comparison retains RowButton/GlyphButton. Selection moves from the former native selected_ field into the existing Rust ActionControl on state.

The shared parent retains kind22/category and kind23/dismiss scenes, Rust action-group geometry, native fonts and no child Label/FocusRing instances. Scene reads Rust enabled/focused/on/visual snapshots; native input/focus/AX/window adapters and existing category/filter/close callbacks remain.

Preference group scheduling synchronously checks individual clipped controls, including while the parent group is still visible and GPU work is pending. Capture/blur/control/widget hiding/disable cancel through the common Rust host.

The shared glyph action host now compares pre/post visual state before scheduling paint. If pending input retires without a visual change it still notifies the owner so row-close input watches are cleaned up. Repeated unchanged hover moves do not submit another category scene; no controlled performance gain is inferred.

The new shared case verifies actual host types, AX metadata, selection, Mac Return and disabled admission, preference AX close and physical tools-close Space. Rust-specific branches verify partial group clipping, hide/disable late release and a real category surface frame count remaining unchanged for twenty unchanged hover moves after a hover frame.

Existing physical Cocoa category/filter/responsive choice, preference query/profile/hide lifecycle, tools keyboard/close, layout hierarchy/measurement and shared glyph/row action regressions retain their assertions through View adapters. No dependency, browser service/admission/store or persistence policy change.

previous_full_checkpoint.scope: The previous full checkpoint predates appearance and preference-host changes. This source has targeted acceptance only.
